editorial:
Imagine starting your first job as a security guard at a creepy, old mental hospital, only to vanish without a trace. That is exactly how this story kicks off. You get to see everything through the eyes of the missing guard via his bodycam footage, which makes you feel like you are right there in the dark hallways with him. The vibe is super tense from the start, and it does a great job of making you jump every time a door slams or a shadow moves. It feels like a giant puzzle where you are trying to figure out what happened to the guy before the footage cuts to black.

What really works here is how the movie mixes found footage with new interviews. The acting feels real, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts move a bit slow, the scary moments are worth the wait. If you love a good mystery, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the hidden details in the dark rooms, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: You find out the guard didn't just disappear; he was pulled into a different dimension by the spirits of the hospital. The final twist reveals that the investigators watching the footage are actually being hunted by the same entity. The movie ends with the screen glitching out as the monster grabs the last person in the room, showing that nobody who enters the hospital ever truly leaves.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and found footage films.
